option_relations.rationale: Multidrug-resistant Cytomegalovirus (CMV) infection is a specific type of Cytomegalovirus (CMV) infection with drug resistance.
Ganciclovir-resistant cytomegalovirus (CMV) infection is a specific type of Cytomegalovirus (CMV) infection with drug resistance.
Pneumocystis pneumonia (PCP) is a distinct infection caused by Pneumocystis jirovecii, unrelated to Cytomegalovirus (CMV) infection with drug resistance.

Cytomegalovirus (CMV) disease (pneumonitis/disseminated) is a broader category that could encompass CMV infection, which may or may not have drug resistance. The leaf specifically mentions drug resistance, making the option a supertype.
